title: Lulu's Beef & Broccoli Fried Rice
ingredients: Beef Marinade: 2 tsp dark soy sauce
steps: Combine sliced beef with oyster sauce, dark soy sauce, cornstarch, and set aside for fifteen minutes.
Pour boiling water over the broccoli florets, let sit for two minutes, and drain thoroughly.
Heat oil in a large wok over high heat, add beef in a single layer, and stir fry until browned.
Stir fry garlic, ginger, and spring onion whites for one minute, then add rice and broccoli.
Pour in the mixed sauce, toss until hot, return the beef to the pan, and heat through.
Serve hot topped with a fried egg, a drizzle of chilli oil, and a sprinkle of sesame seeds.
